identitySafeguards: PMID31620223 resolves to the camptothecin-conjugate paper; PMID31620224 resolves to the separate peptide-maytansinoid paper. Both are valid and were not interchanged.
The 2015 polyacetal Fleximer-vinca paper is not the 2021 Dolaflexin-AF-HPA paper.
Substrate behaviour is not transporter inhibition. Free MMAF is not cys-mcMMAF; free DM1 is not Lys-MCC-DM1.
Label BCRP and confirmatory-cell ABCG2 statements for SG3199 are retained with their differing contexts.
The source discussion has a gemtuzumab-vedotin naming error; it was not propagated.
The CL2A abstract contains mathematical less-than signs. Raw text was re-read after a broad tag-stripping helper obscured part of an intermediate display. The original capture was unchanged.
